setup.title: Connect GitHub and start maintenance
details: Connect with a GitHub access token. It is encrypted on this computer. Existing GitHub App connections remain available in the control center.
Choose the API format, enter your gateway and model, then save and test. Keys are never displayed again.
Sync your account and select one or more repositories, or select all. Monitoring alone does not download code.
Detect installed development tools. Missing tools are reported without installing anything.
Observe only monitors. Maintain prepares fixes and PRs. Autonomous also requests merge and release after verification. Remote writes require the system gate.
Read live repository metadata to verify access before enabling scheduled work.
Enable the selected policy. This computer must stay on for local execution.
setup.remoteWrites: Allow remote writes under each repository policy
setup.trustedExecution: Authorize trusted repository scripts on this computer (no OS security sandbox)

upgrade.allowNoCI: Permit merge when no remote CI is configured

guide.entryDetail: Follow the steps to start repository maintenance
guide.title: Set up automatic maintenance
guide.reuseGitHub: Connected as {{account}}. Continue, or enter a new token to reconnect.
guide.reuseAI: {{model}} is configured. Continue with the saved key; leaving it blank does not delete it.
guide.requireTrust: Authorize scripts for this trusted repository, or select Observe.
guide.requireDelivery: Explicitly allow remote writes before enabling automatic delivery.
guide.requirePrereqs: Complete the connection, repository selection and checks first.
guide.keyRequired: Enter an API key, or keep the key of an existing saved provider.
guide.gitRequired: A working Git installation was not found. Install or repair Git, then check again.
guide.pickRepo: Choose the GitHub repository to maintain.
guide.policyLoaded: Current policy loaded. Saving changes pauses this repository until the final enable step.
guide.doneDetail: {{repository}} is checked every {{minutes}} minutes. Eligible issues create repair tasks; otherwise monitoring continues.
guide.keepRunning: Keep this computer on. Closing the window can leave it in the tray; quitting the app stops local work.
guide.limits: Automatic maintenance covers inspection, classification, eligible Issue fixes and authorized delivery. Research proposals still need review; arbitrary upgrades are not automatically implemented.
guide.viewRunLocations: Show me where to track it
guide.inspected: Read {{count}} Issues and identified {{actionable}} new eligible problems.
instructions: Create a token using the access-token link, then paste it below. Next connects and encrypts it. If already connected, continue.
Enter the provider’s API URL and API key, then use Fetch models to choose a model or type its name manually. Choose openai-compatible for compatible gateways. Next saves and tests the connection.
Sync GitHub, then check the repositories to maintain. Select all or deselect all in one click. Policies, checks and hosting apply to every selected repository.
Next checks installed tools. Repairs need Git; builds also need the project's runtime. Missing tools are not installed automatically.
Choose Autonomous for automatic issue handling, authorize trusted scripts and set the interval. Push, PR, merge and release remain subject to individual permissions and verification.
Next reads the real repository and tests AI and tools. Correct failures before retrying. Basic readiness does not validate all CI, signing or publishing permissions.
Allow remote writes, then enable hosting. This actually starts scheduled work; viewing the tutorial does not grant permission.
expected: After connecting, move to AI configuration.
After a successful test, choose a repository.
Confirm the selected repositories, then check local tools.
After Git is available, configure the policy.
After checks pass, review the final authorization.
After enabling, see the actual status and learn where tasks and results appear.
tourDetails: Choose a repository and inspect its enabled state, policy, interval and delivery permissions. Monitoring continues when no work is needed. Pause or disable hosting here.
Queued work, execution and delivery have separate results. Expand blocked tasks to inspect reasons and receipts. Notifications and the AI Agent page show pending approvals.
See monitored Issues and AI classifications here. Only eligible, sufficiently confident classifications enter repair; high-risk problems may require review.
See scheduled source research or run it manually, then review proposals and licenses. Approving a proposal does not automatically implement an arbitrary upgrade.
guide.resumeRequired: The global scheduler is paused. Explicitly resume it before starting automatic work for this repository.

batch.empty: No repositories yet. Sync GitHub first.
batch.applyTo: These settings apply to all {{total}} selected repositories.
batch.trustedExecution: Authorize scripts from all selected trusted repositories to run locally (no operating system sandbox configured)

batch.incomplete: Completed {{successful}} / {{total}} repositories. Review the results and retry unfinished items.
batch.doneDetail: Hosting is enabled for {{total}} repositories, checked every {{minutes}} minutes. Eligible issues create repair tasks; otherwise monitoring continues.
batch.archivedHint: Archived repositories cannot be selected for hosting. Sync GitHub to refresh archive status.
batch.noActive: No repositories available for hosting; all are archived.
batch.selectionChanged: Some selected repositories are archived or unavailable and were deselected. Return to the repository list to confirm before continuing.
